1. Send to all 14 members of project-team, including the consultants.
2. Send only to the 9 Halcyon employees.
3. Hold until finance has reviewed the budget section and the figures are verified.

I recommend option 2 or 3. Which would you like?
Just the employees. The consultants shouldn't see the budget numbers yet.
